sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum in Indonesian consumer names (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) as domestic demand strengthens on pre-Lebaran spending and BI rate-cut expectations; avoid US-exposed FMCG. Rotate into mid-cap local brands with volume growth, take profits on SIPD/AGAR after 12-18% runs, and watch for pullbacks to add.
